topicName: Biomechanics, Exercise Physiology and Sports Psychology

cards.front: What should you know about vo2 max?
cards.back: The maximum volume of oxygen an individual can uptake, transport, and utilise per minute during maximal exercise.

cards.front: What should you know about inverted-u theory?
cards.back: Arousal theory stating performance increases with arousal up to an optimal midpoint, beyond which performance deteriorates.
